author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender is finally here, and after watching it, I had a LOT to say. In this review I break down Tagah and The Denied, the use of Katara, Sokka, Toph and Zuko, and the film's themes of grief and unity as Aang's true finale between The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra. I also dig into the astonishing animation with insight from the artists who worked on it - celebrating the team and exploring how the film passed from Flying Bark to Studio Mir and Studio Ppuri. This is a masterpiece that deserved so much more. Let me know your thoughts in the comments!
